title.zh: 在达沃市奎松大道37-d描笼涯设立Trading国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing the Trading National High School At Barangay 37-d, Quezon Boulevard, Davao City, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Trading National High School At Barangay 37-d, Quezon Boulevard, Davao City, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Trading Quốc gia tại Barangay 37-d, Đô thị Quezon Boulevard, Tỉnh Davao City, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Trading แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ 37-d เทศบาล Quezon Boulevard จังหวัด Davao City และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Trading Nasional di Barangay 37-d, Kotamadya Quezon Boulevard, Provinsi Davao City, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Trading Kebangsaan di Barangay 37-d, Perbandaran Quezon Boulevard, Wilayah Davao City, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7993_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a high school at Barangay 37-D, Quezon Boulevard, Davao City, to be known as Trading National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to implement the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
